notes: Contract changes made on purpose by the SEC-07 fix (audit-project-4.md), written down
before the replay so the comparison can separate them from regressions. Compare against
post-first-refactor code and verified reproducible (13/13 on a second capture).
All four entries below are the same single change observed in four places: the stub
payment gateway no longer approves, so the two checkouts that used to succeed are now
declined and the two reports no longer count their revenue.
since those passwords no longer have committed defaults (SEC-01) and the spec signs in

checkout-new-user.from: 201 enrollment created, payment recorded as PAID
checkout-new-user.reason: The stub approved any card beginning with 4 without contacting a provider, so this request bought a 497.00 course for free. The placeholder now declines, because a capability it cannot verify is one it must not grant. A request that used to forge an authorization being refused is the fix, not a regression.

checkout-existing-user.from: 201 enrollment created for the already-seeded user
checkout-existing-user.reason: Same cause as checkout-new-user: the approval was never real. Whether the user already existed made no difference to the forged authorization.

report-after-checkouts.from: Clean Architecture revenue 1994 with two Leonan enrollments; Docker revenue 497 with one student
report-after-checkouts.to: Clean Architecture revenue 997 with one enrollment; Docker revenue 0 with no students
report-after-checkouts.reason: The report is downstream of the two declined checkouts. The earlier figures counted money that was never charged, which is the Impact line of SEC-07 — the report was wrong in a way no reader could detect from the output. The remaining 997 is the seeded enrollment, which has a genuine payment row.

report-after-delete.from: revenue 1994 across two anonymized enrollments; Docker 497
report-after-delete.to: revenue 997 for one anonymized enrollment; Docker 0
report-after-delete.reason: Same cause. Anonymization still works: the surviving enrollment shows as 'Conta removida' with its payment intact, which is the DAT-03 behaviour from the first refactor and is unchanged.
